crossRefs.note: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

people.name: Abishur
people.line: Son of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah

people.name: Jada
people.line: Son of Onam and brother of Shammai.

people.name: Nadab
people.line: Son of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah.

people.name: Onam
people.line: Descendant of Judah, son of Jerahmeel

people.name: Shammai
people.line: Son of Onam; father of Nadab and Abishur

translations.web: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
translations.bsb: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
translations.asv: And the sons of Onam were Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai: Nadab, and Abishur.
